Sana          ₹42,000

fields.question_text:
❓ Question

Sajjad Ali is working with an Excel worksheet containing 5,000 employee records. While scrolling down, the column headings disappear, making it difficult to identify the data.

Which Excel feature should he use?
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation
----------------------

Freeze Panes is an Excel feature that keeps selected rows or columns visible while scrolling through a worksheet.

It is especially useful when working with large datasets because important headings or labels remain visible, making the data easier to read and analyze.

Freeze Panes does not modify the data; it only changes how the worksheet is displayed.

⭐ Interview / Viva Tip
-----------------------------

There are three Freeze Panes options in Excel:

• Freeze Panes – Freezes rows and columns above and to the left of the selected cell.
• Freeze Top Row – Keeps only the first row visible.
• Freeze First Column – Keeps only the first column visible.

📖 Key Point
------------------

Example:

Employee ID | Employee Name | Department | Salary
--------------------------------------------------
101         | Sajjad Ali    | IT         | ₹55,000
102         | Sana          | HR         | ₹42,000
103         | Bushra        | Finance    | ₹48,000
...
5000 records

Without Freeze Panes:
The header row disappears while scrolling.

With Freeze Panes:
The header row remains visible, making it easy to identify each column.

fields.question_text:
❓ Question

Sajjad Ali has the Employee Code EMP1025 in cell A2. He wants to extract only the first 3 characters ("EMP").

Which Excel function should he use?
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation
---------------------

The LEFT() function is used to extract a specified number of characters from the beginning (left side) of a text string.

Syntax:
=LEFT(text, num_chars)

It is commonly used to extract prefixes from employee IDs, product codes, invoice numbers, and other text-based identifiers.

⭐ Interview / Viva Tip
-----------------------------

Remember these three text functions:

LEFT()  → Extracts characters from the beginning.
RIGHT() → Extracts characters from the end.
MID()   → Extracts characters from the middle of a text string.

📖 Key Point
------------------

Example:

Employee Code:
EMP1025

Formula:
=LEFT("EMP1025",3)

Result:
EMP

Other Examples:

=RIGHT("EMP1025",4)
Result:
1025

=MID("EMP1025",4,2)
Result:
10

fields.question_text:
❓ Question

Which Excel function is used to display the current date automatically in a worksheet?
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation
----------------------

The TODAY() function in Excel returns the current date according to the computer's system date.

Syntax:
=TODAY()

It updates automatically whenever the worksheet is opened or recalculated.

It is commonly used in attendance sheets, age calculations, deadline tracking, employee records, and financial reports.


⭐ Interview / Viva Tip
---------------------------------

Difference between TODAY() and NOW():

TODAY() → Returns only the current date.

NOW() → Returns the current date along with the current time.

📖 Key Point
-----------------

Example:

Formula:
=TODAY()

Result:
02-Aug-2026

Formula:
=NOW()

Result:
02-Aug-2026 11:30 AM

fields.question_text:
❓ Question

Saba is creating a sales report in Excel. Some formulas show errors like #DIV/0! and she wants to display a custom message instead of the error.

Which Excel function should she use?
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation
-----------------------

The IFERROR() function in Excel is used to handle formula errors by returning a custom value when a formula produces an error.

Syntax:
=IFERROR(value, value_if_error)

It helps create clean and professional reports by replacing error messages like #N/A, #DIV/0!, #VALUE!, and #REF! with meaningful text or alternative values.

⭐ Interview / Viva Tip
-----------------------------

Common Excel errors:

#DIV/0! → Division by zero.
#N/A    → Value not available.
#VALUE! → Wrong data type used.
#REF!   → Invalid cell reference.

IFERROR() is commonly used in dashboards and financial reports to improve readability.

📖 Key Point
----------------------

Example:

Formula:
=A2/B2

If B2 = 0:
Result:
#DIV/0!

Using:

=IFERROR(A2/B2,"Not Available")

Result:
Not Available

fields.question_text:
Situation 1:

A police officer bina proper reason ke kisi person ko physically assault karta hai.

Police officer ke against kya legal action possible hai?
fields.option2: Complaint/FIR aur legal action le sakte hain
fields.option3: Sirf social media post kar sakte hain
fields.explanation:
Police officers bhi law ke under accountable hote hain.
Agar kisi officer dwara illegal violence ya abuse of power hota hai,
toh victim complaint/FIR aur appropriate legal remedies le sakta hai.

Evidence jaise medical report, witnesses, video recording
case ko support kar sakte hain.

fields.question_text:
📌 Situation 2 :
Sajjad Ali ko police station me bina kisi valid reason ke maara gaya aur uske saath unnecessary force use ki gayi.

Question:

Is situation me kaunsa legal provision relevant ho sakta hai?
fields.option1: BNS Section related to voluntarily causing hurt
fields.explanation:
💡Explanation
-------------------------

If any person causes physical injury intentionally, it may become an offence under criminal law.

Police officers are also accountable under law. 
The exact section depends on the type of injury, intention, evidence, and circumstances.

Citizen Action:
-----------------

• Medical examination karwaye.
• Evidence preserve kare.
• Senior police officer ya appropriate authority ko complaint kare.
• Legal advice le.

fields.question_text:
📌 Situation 3 :

Zaya ko koi person private photos leak karne ki dhamki de raha hai aur paise maang raha hai.

Question:

Kaunsa law relevant ho sakta hai?
fields.option1: BNS Extortion related provisions + IT Act provisions
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:
-------------------------

Threatening someone to obtain money or benefit can be treated as extortion.

If digital content, photos, messages, or online platforms are involved,
Information Technology laws may also apply.


Citizen Action:
-----------------------

• Screenshots aur evidence save kare.
• Blackmailer ko paise na de.
• Cyber complaint/police complaint kare.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 4: FIR Awareness

📌 Situation:

Sajjad Ali ke area me ek person ke saath theft (chori) ka incident hota hai. Woh police station jaakar complaint karna chahta hai, lekin use nahi pata ki legal process kaise start hoti hai.

❓ Question:

Agar kisi person ke saath cognizable crime hota hai, toh police record me officially complaint register karne ke liye kaunsi process hoti hai?

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
⚖️ Cognizable Offence Means:

Aisa crime jisme police bina court ke pehle order ke bhi investigation start kar sakti hai aur certain situations me arrest kar sakti hai (law ke according).

Cognizable offence me police ko investigation start karne ke liye pehle court permission ki zarurat nahi hoti.

Example:
Murder, robbery jaise serious offences.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation: 

FIR (First Information Report) police ko kisi cognizable offence ki pehli information dene ka official record hota hai.

FIR register hone ke baad police investigation process start kar sakti hai.

FIR crime ki details, time, place aur incident se related information ko record karti hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Incident ki details clearly bataye.
• Available evidence preserve kare.
• FIR ki copy zaroor le.
• Galat information provide na kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Har complaint FIR nahi hoti.

Kuch matters me police complaint ya NCR (Non-Cognizable Report) process bhi ho sakta hai.

Crime ki nature ke according legal process decide hota hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 5 : FIR vs Police Complaint

📌 Situation:

Pooja ke phone par kisi unknown person ne abusive messages bheje aur woh police station jaakar help lena chahti hai. Use confusion hai ki sirf complaint kare ya FIR register karwaye.

❓ Question:

FIR aur Police Complaint ke beech basic difference kya hai?
fields.option1: FIR sirf legal record hota hai jo cognizable offence ki information par register hota hai, jabki complaint general information/request ho sakti hai.
fields.option2: FIR aur Complaint dono bilkul same hote hain.
fields.option3: Complaint kabhi police ko nahi di ja sakti.
fields.option4: FIR sirf civil matters ke liye hoti hai.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Police Complaint kisi bhi problem ya incident ke baare me police ko di gayi information hoti hai.

FIR (First Information Report) ek official document hota hai jo generally cognizable offence ki information milne par register kiya jata hai.

Dono ka purpose incident ko report karna hai, lekin unka legal process alag ho sakta hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Problem ki complete details bataye.
• Messages, screenshots, photos ya other evidence save kare.
• Complaint/FIR ki copy ya acknowledgement zaroor le.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Police station jaate waqt ghabraye nahi.

Apni problem clearly explain kare aur available proof ke saath report kare.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 6: Online Fraud Awareness

📌 Situation:

Rahim ko ek unknown person ka call aata hai. Woh khud ko bank employee batata hai aur Rahim se OTP maangta hai.

Rahim OTP share kar deta hai aur kuch time baad uske bank account se paise nikal jaate hain.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Rahim ko sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Dobara OTP share karke problem solve karni chahiye.
fields.option2: Bank ko inform karke aur cyber fraud complaint register karni chahiye.
fields.option3: Kuch nahi karna chahiye kyunki paisa wapas nahi aa sakta.
fields.option4: Apna ATM card kisi aur ko de dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Online banking fraud me jaldi action lena bahut important hota hai.

Agar kisi person ke saath OTP fraud, UPI fraud ya online financial fraud hota hai,
toh victim ko turant bank ko inform karna chahiye aur official cyber crime reporting system ke through complaint karni chahiye.

OTP, PIN aur banking passwords kabhi bhi kisi ke saath share nahi karne chahiye.


🛡️ Citizen Action:

• OTP ya PIN kabhi share na kare.
• Bank ko immediately inform kare.
• Transaction details aur screenshots save kare.
• Cyber fraud complaint file kare.


⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Bank, RBI ya government officials kabhi bhi phone par OTP, PIN ya password nahi maangte.

"Urgent" ya "Account block ho jayega" jaise messages aksar fraud ka signal ho sakte hain.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 7 : Arrest Rights Awareness

📌 Situation:

Faisal ko police kisi investigation ke purpose se arrest karti hai. Faisal ko nahi pata ki arrest hone ke baad uske basic rights kya hain.

❓ Question:

Arrest ke time citizen ka basic right kya hai?
fields.option1: Police ko bina reason bataye hamesha arrest kar sakti hai.
fields.option2: Person ko arrest ka reason bataya jana chahiye aur legal assistance ka right hota hai.
fields.option3: Arrest ke baad person kisi se contact nahi kar sakta.
fields.option4: Sirf rich log legal help le sakte hain.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Indian law ke under arrested person ko certain basic rights milte hain.

Person ko arrest ka reason bataya jana chahiye aur use legal assistance lene ka adhikar hota hai.

Law enforcement agencies ko bhi proper legal procedure follow karna hota hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Arrest ka reason samjhe.
• Legal help lene ka request kare.
• Family ya trusted person ko inform karne ki process follow kare.
• Apne rights ko calmly use kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Rights ka use karna aur police ke saath cooperate karna dono important hain.

Citizen rights aur legal duties dono saath-saath chalte hain.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation  8 : Consumer Rights Awareness

📌 Situation:

Bushra ne ek online shopping website se mobile order kiya. Product deliver hone ke baad pata chala ki mobile damaged hai aur seller replacement ya refund dene se mana kar raha hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Bushra kis right ka use kar sakti hai?
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Consumer Protection laws customers ko defective products, poor services,
unfair trade practices aur misleading advertisements se protection provide karte hain.

Agar kisi consumer ko product ya service me problem hoti hai,
toh woh complaint raise kar sakta hai aur appropriate legal remedy le sakta hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Bill/invoice sambhal kar rakhe.
• Product photos aur videos ka evidence rakhe.
• Seller/customer support se written communication kare.
• Zarurat padne par consumer complaint file kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Consumer hone ke naate receipt, invoice aur warranty documents important proof hote hain.

"Product kharidne ke baad customer ke rights khatam nahi ho jaate."

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 9 : Online Harassment / Cyber Bullying
📌 Situation:

Saba ko social media par ek unknown person baar-baar insulting messages bhej raha hai, uski fake profile bana raha hai aur use mentally disturb kar raha hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Saba ko kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Ignore karke sab evidence delete kar dena chahiye.
fields.option2: Evidence save karke cyber complaint aur legal help leni chahiye.
fields.option3: Apna account password us person ko de dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Online harassment, fake profiles, threats aur cyber bullying serious issues ho sakte hain.

Victim ko messages, screenshots, profile links aur other evidence preserve karna chahiye.

Digital platforms aur legal authorities ke through complaint ki ja sakti hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Screenshots aur proof save kare.
• Harasser ko unnecessary reply na kare.
• Account security improve kare.
• Cyber crime complaint register kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Internet par ki gayi activity bhi law ke under aa sakti hai.

Online harassment ko "sirf mazaak" samajhkar ignore nahi karna chahiye.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 10 : Stalking / Repeated Following Awareness

📌 Situation:

Saba ko ek person baar-baar follow karta hai, unwanted messages bhejta hai aur mana karne ke baad bhi contact karne ki koshish karta rehta hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Saba ko kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Ignore karna aur saare messages delete kar dena.
fields.option2: Evidence save karke complaint aur legal help lena.
fields.option3: Apni personal information share kar dena.
fields.option4: Us person ko paise de dena.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Kisi person ka baar-baar unwanted follow karna, contact karna ya disturb karna
harassment ki category me aa sakta hai.

Victim ko evidence jaise messages, call details, screenshots aur other proof
preserve karne chahiye taaki proper complaint process me help mile.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Messages/call records ka evidence rakhe.
• Trusted family/friends ko inform kare.
• Zarurat padne par police ya appropriate authority ko complaint kare.
• Personal details share karne se bache.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Repeated unwanted contact ko normal behaviour samajhkar ignore nahi karna chahiye.

Safety ke liye early action aur evidence preservation important hota hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 11 : Rishwat Demand Case
📌 Situation:

Aleem ek government office me apna legal kaam karwane gaya. Officer bolta hai:

"Kaam jaldi karwana hai toh ₹5000 dene padenge."

Aleem ke paas officer ki baat ka audio proof hai.

❓ Question:

Is situation me kaunsa law relevant ho sakta hai?
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Public servant dwara illegal gratification (rishwat) maangna
corruption offence ho sakta hai.

Citizen evidence preserve karke appropriate anti-corruption authority
ya legal channel ke through complaint kar sakta hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Rishwat dene se pehle legal options samjhe.
• Evidence preserve kare.
• Official complaint channels use kare.
• Khud se confrontation avoid kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Rishwat sirf lene wala nahi,
illegal demand karna bhi serious matter ho sakta hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 12: Fake Online Loan Fraud
📌 Situation:

Haider ko ek unknown number se call aata hai. Caller bolta hai:

"Aapka instant loan approve ho gaya hai. Bas processing fee ke liye ₹2000 bhej do, phir loan amount account me aa jayega."

Haider paise transfer kar deta hai, lekin uske baad caller phone band kar deta hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi online financial fraud situation me Haider ko kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Aur paise bhejne chahiye taaki loan release ho jaye.
fields.option2: Evidence save karke bank aur cyber crime authority ko report karni chahiye.
fields.option3: Apna OTP aur bank details share karni chahiye.
fields.option4: Fraud hone ke baad kuch nahi karna chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Fake loan offers, fake investment schemes aur online payment scams
financial fraud ke examples ho sakte hain.

Fraud hone ke baad victim ko jaldi action lena important hota hai.

Transaction details, phone numbers, messages aur payment proof
investigation me useful evidence ban sakte hain.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Unknown person ko OTP, PIN ya password na de.
• Payment screenshots aur transaction ID save kare.
• Bank ko immediately inform kare.
• Cyber fraud complaint file kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Real banks generally loan approval ke naam par random calls karke
OTP, PIN ya secret banking information nahi maangte.

"Too good to be true" offers se alert rehna chahiye.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 13: Fake Product / Online Shopping Scam
📌 Situation:

Shoeb ne ek online marketplace se branded headphones order kiye. Delivery ke baad pata chala ki product duplicate hai aur seller refund dene se mana kar raha hai.

Shoeb ke paas:

1. Order invoice
2. Payment proof
3. Product photos

available hain.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Shoeb ke paas kaunsa legal option available ho sakta hai?
fields.option1: Consumer Protection Act ke under complaint raise karna
fields.option2: Khud seller ke saath fight karna
fields.option4: Kisi aur customer ko bech dena
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Agar customer ko defective product, fake product, unfair trade practice
ya misleading information milti hai, toh consumer protection laws ke under
complaint ka option available ho sakta hai.

Invoice, payment proof aur communication jaise documents complaint ko support
karne me help karte hain.


🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Invoice aur payment records safe rakhe.
• Product ke photos/videos evidence ke roop me rakhe.
• Seller/platform ke saath written communication kare.
• Zarurat padne par consumer complaint file kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Online shopping me "proof" sabse important hota hai.

Invoice, order details aur messages future complaint ke liye useful evidence ban sakte hain.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 14: Road Accident & Hit-and-Run Awareness

📌 Situation:

Faisal road par ja raha tha. Ek car driver ne uski bike ko hit kar diya aur accident ke baad driver wahan se bhaag gaya.

Faisal ko injury hui aur kuch logon ne accident dekha.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Faisal ko kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Driver ko khud chase karke fight karni chahiye.
fields.option2: Medical help lena, evidence collect karna aur police complaint karni chahiye.
fields.option3: Accident ko ignore kar dena chahiye.
fields.option4: Apni bike aur accident location ka proof delete kar dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Road accident ke cases me safety sabse important hoti hai.

Victim ko medical treatment lena chahiye aur accident se related evidence
jaise photos, videos, witness details aur vehicle information preserve karni chahiye.

Hit-and-run cases me legal investigation evidence ke basis par hoti hai.


🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Sabse pehle medical help le.
• Accident location ki photos/videos rakhe.
• Witness details note kare.
• Police complaint/report kare.
• Vehicle number ya available information save kare.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Accident ke baad gusse me khud se action lena situation ko aur complicated bana sakta hai.

Legal process aur evidence follow karna zyada effective hota hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 15: Lost Documents / Identity Misuse Awareness

📌 Situation:

Rahim ka wallet market me kho gaya. Usme:

1. Aadhaar card copy
2. PAN card copy
3. Driving licence
4. ATM card tha.

Kuch din baad Rahim ko doubt hota hai ki koi uski identity ka misuse kar sakta hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Rahim ko sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Ignore karna chahiye kyunki documents ka koi use nahi hota.
fields.option2: Documents loss ki report karni, bank ko inform karna aur misuse se bachne ke steps lene chahiye.
fields.option3: Apne documents ki photo social media par upload karni chahiye.
fields.option4: Apna ATM PIN sabko bata dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Identity documents ka misuse fraud, fake accounts ya unauthorized activities ke liye
kiya ja sakta hai.

Agar important documents lost ho jaye toh timely reporting aur security steps lena
important hota hai.

Personal information ko protect karna digital age me ek important citizen responsibility hai.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Lost documents ki report kare.
• Bank cards ko block kare agar zarurat ho.
• Suspicious activity monitor kare.
• Important documents ki copies secure jagah rakhe.

⭐ Legal Awareness Tip:

Aadhaar, PAN, banking details jaise documents sensitive information hote hain.

Unhe bina zarurat share karna identity theft ka risk badha sakta hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 16: Workplace Harassment
📌 Situation:

Pooja ek company me kaam karti hai. Uska senior repeatedly unwanted comments karta hai aur uncomfortable behaviour karta hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me kaunsa law relevant ho sakta hai?
fields.option1: POSH Act, 2013 (Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act)
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

POSH Act, 2013 workplace par women ko sexual harassment se protection provide karta hai.

Organizations me Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) ka provision hota hai
jahan complaints raise ki ja sakti hain.

🛡️ Citizen Action:

• Incidents ka record maintain kare.
• Company complaint mechanism use kare.
• Zarurat padne par appropriate authority se help le.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 1: Police Refuses to Register FIR
📌 Situation:

Sajjad Ali ka mobile market me snatch ho jata hai. Woh nearest police station jaakar FIR register karwana chahta hai.

Duty officer bina complaint sune bolta hai:

"Yeh hamare area ka case nahi hai. Hum FIR register nahi karenge."

❓ Question:

Agar police FIR register karne se mana kar de, toh Sajjad Ali ke paas agla legal option kya ho sakta hai?
fields.option1: Ghar chale jana aur kuch na karna.
fields.option2: Senior Police Officer (SP/DCP) ya appropriate authority ke paas written complaint dena.
fields.option4: Social media par sirf post kar dena.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation:

Agar kisi cognizable offence ki FIR register karne se police mana karti hai,
toh citizen higher police authorities ke paas written complaint de sakta hai.

Situation ke facts ke hisab se law further remedies bhi provide karta hai.

Har refusal final decision nahi hota.


⚖️ Relevant Law
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023

Relevant Provision:
Section 173(4) BNSS
(Complaint to the Superintendent of Police when information is not recorded.)

Note:
Actual legal remedy depends on the facts of the case.


🛡️ Citizen Action
• Written complaint ki copy rakhe.
• Date, time aur officer ka naam note kare.
• Higher police authority ko complaint bheje.
• Available evidence preserve kare.


⭐ Legal Awareness Tip
Police station FIR lene se mana kare,
iska matlab ye nahi ki citizen ke legal options khatam ho gaye.

Law higher authorities tak complaint pahunchane ka bhi mechanism provide karta hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 2: Fake Police Officer

📌 Situation:

Bushra ko raat me ek call aata hai.

Caller bolta hai:

"Main Crime Branch se bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar card se illegal transactions hue hain. Agar aap abhi ₹25,000 transfer nahi karengi toh aapko arrest kar liya jayega."

Caller Bushra ko video call par police uniform bhi dikhata hai.

❓ Question:

Aisi situation me Bushra ko sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Dar kar turant paise transfer kar dene chahiye.
fields.option2: Caller ki identity verify kiye bina personal details aur OTP share kar dene chahiye.
fields.option3: Call disconnect karke official police station ya cyber helpline se independently verify karna chahiye aur zarurat ho to complaint karni chahiye.
fields.option4: Apna bank account permanently band kar dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Scammers kabhi-kabhi khud ko police, CBI, bank ya government officer batakar
logon ko daraate hain.

Sirf phone call, WhatsApp message ya video call dekhkar kisi ki identity par
bharosa nahi karna chahiye.

Official contact details ke through independently verification karna
aur fraud ka doubt ho to complaint karna safer approach hai.

⚖️ Relevant Law / Category

Relevant Area:

• Cyber Fraud
• Cheating
• Identity Impersonation

Applicable legal provisions case ke facts aur evidence par depend karte hain.


🛡️ Citizen Action

• OTP, PIN ya banking details share na kare.
• Caller ka number aur screenshots save kare.
• Official police/cyber channels se verification kare.
• Fraud ka suspicion ho to complaint register kare.

⚠️ Important Note

Police ya government agencies normally phone par
OTP, UPI PIN ya immediate payment demand nahi karti.

Verification ke bina kabhi payment na kare.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 3: WhatsApp Blackmail

📌 Situation:

Pooja ki kisi unknown person se social media par dosti hoti hai. Kuch dino baad woh person Sana ki edited photos bana kar WhatsApp par bhejta hai aur message karta hai:

"₹50,000 transfer karo, warna ye photos tumhare family aur friends ko bhej dunga."

Sana ke paas chats aur screenshots available hain.

❓ Question:

Is situation me kaunsa legal offence sabse zyada relevant ho sakta hai?
fields.option1: Extortion / Criminal Intimidation + Applicable Cyber Law Provisions
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Kisi person ko dara kar paise ya koi illegal benefit maangna
extortion ya criminal intimidation ke category me aa sakta hai.

Agar incident online platforms, edited images ya digital communication ke through hua hai,
toh cyber laws bhi relevant ho sakte hain.

Actual legal sections case ke facts aur evidence par depend karte hain.


⚖️ Relevant Act / Section

Relevant Laws:

• Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023
  (Extortion / Criminal Intimidation related provisions)

• Information Technology Act, 2000
  (When digital platforms or electronic evidence are involved)

Exact sections depend on investigation and facts.

🛡️ Citizen Action

• Blackmailer ko paise na de.
• Chats, screenshots aur payment requests ka evidence save kare.
• Cyber Crime Portal ya nearest police station me complaint kare.
• Family ya trusted person ko inform kare.

⚠️ Important Note

Blackmailers aksar victim ko dara kar jaldi decision lene par majboor karte hain.

Ghabrahat me payment karne ke bajay evidence preserve karna aur legal authorities se contact karna zyada safe approach hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 4: Fake Property Sale

📌 Situation:

Rahim ko ek person bahut sasti price me plot bechne ka offer deta hai. Seller bolta hai:

"Aaj token amount de do. Documents baad me dikha dunga. Ye offer sirf aaj ke liye hai."

Rahim ko property dekhne ya ownership documents verify karne ka mauka bhi nahi diya jata.

❓ Question:

Rahim ko sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Turant token amount transfer kar dena chahiye.
fields.option2: Property ownership documents verify kiye bina deal final kar deni chahiye.
fields.option3: Ownership documents verify karne chahiye aur legal due diligence ke baad hi payment karni chahiye.
fields.option4: Blank agreement par sign kar dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Property transactions me sirf verbal promises par bharosa nahi karna chahiye.

Ownership documents, title records, approvals aur identity verification
bahut important hote hain.

Jaldi decision lene ka pressure property fraud ka common warning sign ho sakta hai.


⚖️ Relevant Act / Section


Relevant Legal Areas:

• Property Fraud
• Cheating (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 - facts ke anusar)
• Registration laws related to property transactions

Exact legal provisions case ke facts aur investigation par depend karte hain.

🛡️ Citizen Action


• Property documents verify kare.
• Token amount dene se pehle ownership confirm kare.
• Registered agreement aur legal advice consider kare.
• Sabhi payment records preserve kare.


⚠️ Important Note

Agar koi seller bole:

"Abhi payment karo, warna deal cancel."

Toh bina verification ke payment karna risky ho sakta hai.

Property deal me haste se zyada verification zaroori hota hai.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 5: Fake Investment Scam
📌 Situation:

Faisal ko Instagram par ek advertisement dikhta hai:

"₹10,000 invest karo aur sirf 7 din me ₹1,00,000 kamao. 100% Guaranteed Profit."

Faisal ko WhatsApp group me add kiya jata hai. Group me fake profit screenshots dikhaye jate hain aur usse jaldi investment karne ka pressure diya jata hai.

❓ Question:

Is situation me sabse bada Red Flag (Warning Sign) kya hai?
fields.option1: Guaranteed high profit with almost no risk.
fields.option2: Investment se pehle company details verify karna.
fields.option3: Official registration aur licence check karna.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

"Guaranteed" high returns, pressure to invest immediately,
aur fake profit screenshots investment scams ke common warning signs hote hain.

Kisi bhi investment se pehle company ki authenticity,
regulatory registration aur documents verify karna important hota hai.

⚖️ Relevant Act / Section

Relevant Legal Areas:

• Financial Fraud
• Cheating (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 - facts ke anusar)
• Investment-related regulatory laws

Actual legal provisions depend on the nature of the fraud and investigation.

🛡️ Citizen Action

• Company ki authenticity verify kare.
• Official registration aur licence check kare.
• Unknown WhatsApp investment groups par trust na kare.
• Investment se pehle independent financial advice consider kare.

⚠️ Important Note

"Guaranteed profit" aur "No Risk" jaise claims
financial scams me bahut common hote hain.

Agar offer sach hone ke liye bahut hi achha lag raha hai,
toh pehle uski authenticity zaroor verify kare.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ Advertisement Screenshot
✔ WhatsApp Chats
✔ Payment Receipt
✔ Bank Transaction Details

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 6: Fake Digital Arrest Scam

📌 Situation:

Sajjad Ali ko ek video call aata hai. Caller police uniform pehne hue bolta hai:

"Aapka Aadhaar card money laundering case me use hua hai."

Phir woh kehta hai:

"Aap ab Digital Arrest me ho. Kisi se baat mat karna. Investigation complete hone tak video call band mat karna. Agar cooperate nahi kiya toh turant jail bhej denge."

Caller baad me verification ke naam par paise transfer karne ke liye bhi pressure banata hai.

❓ Question:

Is situation me Sajjad Ali ko kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Dar kar video call par hi paise transfer kar dene chahiye.
fields.option2: Video call disconnect karke official police authority ya cyber crime channels se independently verify karna chahiye.
fields.option3: Aadhaar OTP aur bank details share kar deni chahiye.
fields.option4: Mobile phone permanently switch off kar dena chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

"Digital Arrest" ke naam par logon ko dara kar paise vasoolne wale scams
recent years me kaafi dekhe gaye hain.

Koi unknown caller agar police ya government officer bankar
video call par paise, OTP ya confidential information maange,
toh uski identity independently verify karni chahiye.


⚖️ Relevant Act / Section

Relevant Legal Areas:

• Cyber Fraud
• Cheating
• Personation/Impersonation
• Criminal Intimidation (facts ke anusar)

Exact legal provisions investigation aur evidence par depend karte hain.


🛡️ Citizen Action


• Call disconnect kare.
• OTP, PIN ya bank details share na kare.
• Official police number ya cyber crime authority se verify kare.
• Screenshots, call logs aur recordings (agar available ho) preserve kare.

⚠️ Important Note

India me "Digital Arrest" ke naam par bahut scams report hue hain.

Police ya investigating agencies normally video call par
payment transfer karne ke liye pressure nahi banati.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ Video Call Screenshot
✔ Call Recording (if available)
✔ Phone Number
✔ Payment Request Messages

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 7: Secret Camera in a Hotel Room

📌 Situation:

Sana weekend trip ke liye ek hotel me stay karti hai. Room me enter karne ke baad use smoke detector ke andar ek hidden camera jaisa device dikhai deta hai.

Woh device ki photos leti hai aur hotel staff ko batati hai. Staff bolta hai:

"Madam, aap galat samajh rahi hain. Kisi ko mat batana, hum room change kar dete hain."

❓ Question:

Is situation me Sana ko sabse appropriate action kya lena chahiye?
fields.option1: Sirf room change karke baat khatam kar deni chahiye.
fields.option2: Device ko tod dena chahiye taaki koi evidence na rahe.
fields.option3: Evidence preserve karke police ko inform karna aur appropriate legal complaint karni chahiye.
fields.option4: Social media par live aakar bina complaint kiye sab expose kar dena.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Agar kisi hotel ya private place me hidden camera ka genuine suspicion ho,
toh evidence preserve karna bahut important hai.

Khud device ko destroy karne se investigation me important evidence khatam ho sakta hai.

Police aur investigating authorities evidence ke basis par determine karti hain
ki offence hua hai ya nahi aur kaunse legal provisions apply honge.


⚖️ Relevant Act / Section

Relevant Legal Areas:

• Right to Privacy
• Voyeurism (where applicable)
• Information Technology Act, 2000 (if digital recording/transmission is involved)
• Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023 (facts ke anusar)

Exact sections depend on investigation and the facts of the case.

🛡️ Citizen Action

• Device ko touch ya damage na kare.
• Photos/videos safely preserve kare.
• Hotel bill aur room details sambhal kar rakhe.
• Police ko inform kare aur written complaint de.

⚠️ Important Note

Har unusual device hidden camera nahi hota.

Lekin agar genuine suspicion ho,
toh matter ko professionally report karna aur evidence preserve karna sabse safe approach hai.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ Room Photos
✔ Hidden Device Photo
✔ Hotel Booking Receipt
✔ CCTV (Hotel)
✔ Witness Statements (if any)

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 8: Fake Property Documents

📌 Situation:

Shoeb apna flat bechna chahta hai. Ek buyer usse property ke documents bhejta hai aur bolta hai:

"Sab documents genuine hain. Verification ki zarurat nahi hai. Bas aaj agreement sign kar do."

Shoeb ka dost documents check karta hai aur notice karta hai ki stamp paper aur registration details me mismatch hai.

❓ Question:

Agar kisi property transaction me forged (fake) documents ka suspicion ho, toh Shoeb ko sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Verification ke bina agreement sign kar dena.
fields.option2: Documents ki authenticity verify karni chahiye aur suspicion ho to legal advice aur appropriate authority ki help leni chahiye.
fields.option3: Buyer ko advance payment wapas bhej dena aur sab proof delete kar dena.
fields.option4: Blank papers par sign kar dena.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Property transactions me forged documents ka use financial fraud ka hissa ho sakta hai.

Agreement sign karne se pehle ownership, registration records aur supporting documents verify karna bahut important hai.

Verification ke bina sign karne se legal aur financial risk badh sakta hai.


⚖️ Relevant Act / Section

Relevant Legal Areas:

• Forgery
• Cheating
• Property Fraud

Applicable provisions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023
aur anya relevant property laws facts aur investigation ke hisab se decide hote hain.


🛡️ Citizen Action

• Original documents verify kare.
• Registration records independently check kare.
• Blank documents par kabhi sign na kare.
• Zarurat padne par legal expert se advice le.

⚠️ Important Note

Fraudsters aksar bolte hain:

"Sirf aaj ka offer hai."

Ya

"Verification ki zarurat nahi."

Property transaction me jaldi se zyada verification important hota hai.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ Property Documents
✔ Registration Details
✔ WhatsApp Chats
✔ Token Payment Receipt
✔ Email Communication

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 9: ATM Card Swap Fraud
📌 Situation:

Aleem ATM se paise nikalne jata hai. Machine me problem aati hai. Ek unknown person help karne ke bahane Aleem ka ATM card lekar "check" karta hai aur chupke se uska card badal deta hai.

30 minutes baad Aleem ke account se ₹45,000 withdraw ho jate hain.

❓ Question:

Is situation me Aleem ko sabse pehla kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Ek din wait karna chahiye, shayad paise wapas aa jaye.
fields.option2: Turant bank ko inform karke card block karwana aur cyber/police complaint karni chahiye.
fields.option3: ATM ka PIN WhatsApp par bank ko bhejna chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

ATM card swapping ek common financial fraud hai.

Jitni jaldi bank ko inform karke card block kiya jata hai,
utna hi unauthorized transactions ko rokne ka chance badhta hai.

Complaint ke liye transaction details aur CCTV footage bhi useful ho sakte hain.

⚖️ Relevant Legal Area

• Banking Fraud
• Cyber Crime
• Financial Cheating


🛡️ Citizen Action

• Card immediately block kare.
• Bank customer care ko inform kare.
• Transaction statement download kare.
• ATM location aur time note kare.
• Police/Cyber Crime complaint kare.

⚠️ Important Note

ATM me kisi unknown person se help lene se bache.

PIN enter karte waqt keypad ko hamesha cover kare.


📂 Evidence Available

✔ ATM Receipt
✔ Bank SMS
✔ Transaction History
✔ CCTV Footage
✔ ATM Location & Time

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 10: Fake Job Offer Scam
📌 Situation:

Bushra ko email aata hai:

"Congratulations! Aap Google India me select ho gaye hain."

Email me joining letter bhi attached hai. Lekin joining se pehle ₹8,500 "Document Verification Fee" maangi jaati hai.

Company ke HR se contact karne par pata chalta hai ki unhone aisa koi offer letter issue hi nahi kiya.

❓ Question:

Is situation me Bushra ko kya karna chahiye?
fields.option1: Verification fee turant pay kar deni chahiye.
fields.option2: Offer letter ko ignore karke email delete kar dena chahiye.
fields.option3: Payment na kare, evidence preserve kare aur job fraud ki complaint kare.
fields.option4: Apne bank account ki details email par bhej deni chahiye.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Genuine companies normally candidate se recruitment ya joining ke liye
verification fee ya job guarantee ke naam par paise nahi maangti.

Agar offer suspicious lage, toh company ki official website ya HR se
independently verify karna chahiye.

⚖️ Relevant Legal Area

• Job Recruitment Fraud
• Financial Cheating
• Cyber Crime (if email/online platform is used)

🛡️ Citizen Action

• Koi payment na kare.
• Email aur offer letter preserve kare.
• Official HR se verification kare.
• Cyber Crime/Police me complaint kare agar fraud confirm ho.

⚠️ Important Note

Agar koi company joining se pehle
"Registration Fee", "Security Deposit"
ya "Document Verification Charges" maange,

toh pehle uski authenticity zaroor verify kare.


📂 Evidence Available
✔ Fake Offer Letter
✔ Email Headers
✔ Payment Request
✔ WhatsApp Chats
✔ Company HR Confirmation

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 11: Blank Cheque Fraud

📌 Situation:

Haider ne apne dost ko emergency ke liye ek signed blank cheque de diya.

Kuch mahino baad usse bank se notice milta hai ki cheque par ₹8,50,000 bhar kar deposit kiya gaya tha, jabki Haider ne itni amount kabhi likhi hi nahi thi.

❓ Question:

Is situation me sabse badi galti kya thi?
fields.option1: Signed blank cheque kisi ko de dena.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation


Blank cheque par sign karke kisi ko dena bahut risky ho sakta hai.

Cheque me amount aur details baad me badli ja sakti hain,
jisse financial aur legal disputes khade ho sakte hain.

Cheque issue karte waqt amount, date aur payee name khud fill karna safer practice hai.


⚖️ Relevant Legal Area

• Cheque Misuse
• Financial Dispute
• Banking Transactions

🛡️ Citizen Action

• Kabhi bhi signed blank cheque issue na kare.
• Agar misuse ka doubt ho to bank ko immediately inform kare.
• Sabhi banking records aur communication preserve kare.
• Zarurat padne par legal advice le.

⚠️ Important Note

Blank cheque, blank stamp paper aur blank signed documents
kabhi bhi kisi ko na dein.

Ye future me serious financial disputes ka reason ban sakte hain.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ Original Cheque
✔ Bank Statement
✔ Cheque Deposit Details
✔ SMS Alerts
✔ Bank Notice

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 12: Road Rage Incident

📌 Situation:

Sajjad Ali traffic signal par apni bike se khada tha. Ek car driver uski bike ko halka sa hit kar deta hai. Jab Sajjad Ali baat karne jata hai, driver gaadi se utar kar us par attack karne ki koshish karta hai.

Apni safety ke liye Sajjad Ali attacker ko zor se dhakka deta hai. Attacker gir jata hai aur uske haath me fracture ho jata hai.

❓ Question:

Is situation me Sajjad Ali ke action ko kaise dekha ja sakta hai?
fields.option1: Har situation me ye automatically crime hai.
fields.option2: Agar force sirf apni safety ke liye aur reasonable limit me use ki gayi ho, to self-defence ka principle relevant ho sakta hai.
fields.option3: Fracture hua hai, isliye hamesha murder ka case banega.
fields.option4: Road accident ke baad kisi ko bhi dhakka dena hamesha legal hota hai.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Law self-defence (private defence) ka right recognize karta hai.

Lekin use ki gayi force situation ke hisab se reasonable honi chahiye.

Har case me investigation, CCTV, witness statements aur evidence dekhkar hi
decide kiya jata hai ki self-defence apply hota hai ya nahi.


⚖️ Relevant Legal Area

• Right of Private Defence
• Assault
• Road Rage Incidents


🛡️ Citizen Action

• Apni safety ko priority dein.
• Police ko incident report karein.
• CCTV aur witness details preserve karein.
• Medical records sambhal kar rakhein.


⚠️ Important Note

Self-defence ka right unlimited nahi hota.

Situation khatam hone ke baad badla lena ya unnecessary violence use karna
alag legal consequences la sakta hai.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ CCTV Footage
✔ Witness Statements
✔ Medical Reports
✔ Vehicle Damage Photos
✔ Dashcam Recording (if available)

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 13: Fight or Murder?\

📌 Situation:

Rahim aur Sajjad ke beech road par jhagda ho jata hai.

Gusse me Rahim Sajjadko sirf ek mukka marta hai. Sajjad girta hai, uska sir road ke divider se takra jata hai aur hospital me uski death ho jati hai.

Police investigation me pata chalta hai ki Rahim ke paas koi weapon nahi tha aur uska Sajjad ko maarne ka pehle se koi plan bhi nahi tha.

❓ Question:

Is situation me sabse important legal factor kya hoga?
fields.option1: Victim ki death hui, isliye har case automatically murder hoga
fields.option2: Court intention, knowledge, circumstances aur evidence dekhkar offence decide karegi
fields.option3: Sirf ek punch tha, isliye koi offence nahi hua.
fields.option4: Witness na ho to case khatam ho jayega.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Har death ko law automatically murder nahi maanta.

Investigation me intention (mens rea), knowledge,
circumstances, medical evidence aur witness statements
jaise factors dekhe jaate hain.

Inhi facts ke basis par appropriate offence determine hota hai.


⚖️ Relevant Legal Area


• Homicide-related offences
• Criminal liability
• Intention vs Knowledge

🛡️ Citizen Action

• Incident ke baad evidence destroy na kare.
• Police investigation me cooperate kare.
• False statement dene se bache.

⚠️ Important Note

Har death = Murder ❌

Law har case ke facts ko alag se evaluate karta hai.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ CCTV Footage
✔ Medical/Post-mortem Report
✔ Witness Statements
✔ Scene Photographs

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 14: False Theft Accusation
📌 Situation:

Sajjad Ali ek shopping mall me shopping kar raha tha.

Mall se bahar nikalte hi security guards use rok lete hain aur kehte hain:

"Tumne mobile chori kiya hai."

Sajjad Ali kehta hai ki usne koi chori nahi ki. Security guards uski permission ke bina uska bag kholne ki koshish karte hain aur use 3 ghante tak ek room me baitha kar rakhte hain.

Baad me CCTV footage se pata chalta hai ki asli chor koi aur tha.

❓ Question:

Is situation me sabse sahi statement kaunsi hai?
fields.option1: Sirf shak ke basis par kisi bhi person ko ghanto tak rokna hamesha legal hota hai.
fields.option2: Agar theft prove nahi hua, to security guards kabhi responsible nahi ho sakte.
fields.option3: Kisi vyakti ko sirf shak ke basis par bina proper legal authority ke unnecessarily rokna legal issues create kar sakta hai.
fields.option4: Mall security kisi ko jitni der chahe rok sakti hai.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Mall security ka kaam safety maintain karna hai, lekin kisi person ke rights ka bhi dhyan rakhna zaroori hai.

Agar kisi ko sirf suspicion ke basis par bina proper justification ke lambi der tak roka jata hai, to uske legal consequences ho sakte hain.

Har case ke facts aur evidence ke basis par authorities decide karti hain ki action lawful tha ya nahi.

⚖️ Relevant Legal Area
•  Wrongful Restraint / Wrongful Confinement (facts ke anusar)
•  Personal Liberty
•  Private Security Responsibilities


🛡️ Citizen Action

•  Calm rahein aur cooperate karein.
•  Agar galat tareeke se roka gaya ho to evidence preserve karein.
•  CCTV, witnesses aur incident details note karein.
•  Zarurat padne par legal complaint karein.

⚠️ Important Note

Har suspicion ka matlab guilt nahi hota.

Investigation aur evidence ke bina kisi ko criminal treat nahi kiya ja sakta.

fields.question_text:
🚨 Situation 15: Fake Kidnapping Call
📌 Situation:

Faisal office me kaam kar raha hota hai. Achanak uski maa ko ek unknown number se call aata hai.

Caller chillate hue kehta hai:

"Humne Faisal ko kidnap kar liya hai! Agar 30 minute ke andar ₹5,00,000 nahi bheje, toh use maar denge."

Call ke dauran Faisal ka phone switch off milta hai kyunki uski battery dead ho chuki hoti hai.

Family panic me aa jaati hai.

❓ Question:

Is situation me sabse pehla aur sabse sahi step kya hona chahiye?
fields.option1: Dar kar turant paise transfer kar dena.
fields.option2: Caller se argue karna aur use gaali dena.
fields.option3: Faisal ke office, relatives ya doston se independently contact karke uski location verify karna aur saath hi police ko inform karna.
fields.option4: Social media par post karke help maangna.
fields.explanation:
💡 Explanation

Aise fake kidnapping calls ka purpose family ko panic me laakar turant paise transfer karwana hota hai.

Pehle independent sources se person ki safety verify karni chahiye aur bina confirmation ke ransom transfer nahi karna chahiye.

Emergency situation me police ko jaldi inform karna bhi important hai.


⚖️ Relevant Legal Area
•  Extortion
•  Criminal Intimidation
•  Cyber/Telecom-enabled Fraud

🛡️ Citizen Action
•  Panic me payment na kare.
•  Victim ki location independently verify kare.
•  Call recording, phone number aur messages preserve kare.
•  Police aur cyber authorities ko inform kare.

⚠️ Important Note

Scammers aksar victim ke family members ko emotional pressure me laakar jaldi decision lene par majboor karte hain.

Verification aur quick reporting fraud ko rokne me help kar sakti hai.

📂 Evidence Available

✔ Call Recording (if available)
✔ Phone Number
✔ Bank Payment Request
✔ Call Log
✔ CCTV/Office Attendance (if applicable)
